exact_statement: For every Boolean g(z,Y) on the independent uniform physical cube, if every positive conditional squared Fourier law of S_Y given S_z=b is coordinate product, allowing arbitrary marginals, deterministic frequency coordinates and arbitrary signs, then every varying conditional marginal is fair; if both branches are positive their masses are exactly1/2. Consequently H(g)<=2I(g) sharply in every dimension, in bits and original physical influence. More generally every nonzero integer ternary physical row with product normalized squared spectrum has reduced dyadic norm numerator1 modulo4; thus no ternary product spectrum with norm3/8 is realizable by any signs in any dimension.

exact_statement: There exist fixed complementary ternary/indicator rows a,b on four uniform physical bits, with E a^2=5/8 and E b^2=3/8, such that for every Boolean seed h on a disjoint uniform cube, F_h(z,u,x)=a(u)+z*b(u)*h(x) is Boolean, its z-frequency0 normalized squared row remains the same coordinate-product law with three fair marginals and one4:1 marginal, its other row is nonproduct, H(F_h)=5-(9/16)log2(3)+(3/8)H(h), I(F_h)=17/8+(3/8)I(h), I_z=3/8 and I_(u,x)=7/4+(3/8)I(h). With X=(z,unused d) and Y=(u,x), H(Y|X)=(5/8)[7/5+log2(5)]+(3/8)[3-(1/2)log2(3)+H(h)] and the signed address/order1/2-Renyi gap is3/4-2log2(3)-(3/8)R(h). For h_t=ell times t independent copies of any nonconstant Boolean seed f, the joint and conditional/data-influence ratios tend to H(f)/I(f), while the address/seed spectral mutual information is exactly h2(3/8). A universal FEI bound on this fixed-mask one-product-branch class therefore implies full FEI at the same constant; no unbounded-ratio Boolean seed or full-FEI proof is supplied.
